# awscc_ec2_fpga_image (Resource)

Creates and manages an Amazon FPGA Image (AFI) from a design checkpoint (DCP).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description for the AFI.
- `input_storage_location` (Attributes) The location of the encrypted design checkpoint in Amazon S3. The input must be a tarball. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--input_storage_location))
- `logs_storage_location` (Attributes) The location in Amazon S3 for the output logs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs_storage_location))
- `name` (String) A name for the AFI.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags assigned to the FPGA image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the FPGA image.
- `create_time` (String) The date and time the AFI was created.
- `data_retention_support` (Boolean) Indicates whether data retention support is enabled for the AFI.
- `fpga_image_global_id` (String) The global FPGA image identifier (AGFI ID).
- `fpga_image_id` (String) The FPGA image identifier (AFI ID).
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `owner_id` (String) The ID of the AWS account that owns the AFI.
- `public` (Boolean) Indicates whether the AFI is public.
- `state` (String) The state of the AFI (pending | available | failed | unavailable).
- `update_time` (String) The time of the most recent update to the AFI.

<a id="nestedatt--input_storage_location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `input_storage_location`

Optional:

- `bucket` (String) The name of the S3 bucket.
- `key` (String) The key.


<a id="nestedatt--logs_storage_location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs_storage_location`

Optional:

- `bucket` (String) The name of the S3 bucket.
- `key` (String) The key.

### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ec2_fpga_image.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the FPGA image

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ec2_fpga_image.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_ec2_fpga_image.example "arn"
```
